model.name: gpu9_max512_chat
model.description: Biggest-possible 1660 Ti 6GB chat model at T=512. C=768 L=12 H=12 (hd=64), ~86M params, est ~3.0GB of the 5GB process budget resident (B=1/accum=16, no recompute). BPE-2000 English + chat/tool mix. Fresh weights; never --resume another arch.

metadata.description: 36h budget ~= 9000 optimizer steps x 8192 tokens (B=1, accum=16, T=512) ~= 74M tokens. Smoke measured ~12.5s/step, so 9000 steps is ~31h. Pass --steps 9000 as the cosine length. Stride 256 halves window overlap so limited steps see more unique text. Probe with tools/n50_probe.py; chat with interactive.py --chat or tools/assistant_tools.py.
